step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and Noise Figure of the LNA core.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LNA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Generic NPN model since SKY130 doesn't have a simple 'npn' device
.model npn npn (bf=100 is=1e-14 vaf=50 cjc=1p cje=2p)

* DUT
Q1 n4 n0 n3 npn
Q2 n1 n1 n4 npn
Q3 n2 n1 n0 npn
Q4 n0 n4 GND npn
R1 n3 GND 50
R2 n1 n2 1k
I1 label_net_0 n2 5m

* Biasing and Supplies
V_vdd label_net_0 0 1.8

* RF Input (AC and Transient)
V_in in_src 0 dc 0 ac 2 sin(0 10m 900Meg)
R_in in_src in_ac 50
C_in in_ac n4 10p

* RF Output
C_out n0 out_ac 10p
R_load out_ac 0 50

.control
* DC Analysis
op
let power = -i(V_vdd) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 50 100Meg 10Gig
let gain_db = vdb(out_ac)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
meas ac gain_900m find gain_db at=900Meg
meas ac gain_1_9g find gain_db at=1.9Gig

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 5n
meas tran vout_pp pp v(out_ac)

* Noise Analysis
noise v(out_ac, 0) V_in dec 20 100Meg 10Gig
setplot noise1
* Calculate NF in dB (8e-19 is 4*k*T*50 at 290K)
let nf_db = 10 * log10(inoise_spectrum / 8e-19)
meas noise nf_900m find nf_db at=900Meg
meas noise nf_1_9g find nf_db at=1.9Gig

quit
.endc
.end
